title: Collateral Protection Insurance Program Terms — Plan Assignment and Scope of Placed Coverage
content:
**1. Plan on opening.** A Collateral Protection Insurance tracking record is opened in the CollateralGuard plan whose vehicle value band contains the vehicle's value.

**2. Plan on placement.** When coverage is placed, the plan is set again from the band that contains the vehicle's value on the placement date, using the product's valuation for plan bands.

**3. What the plan fixes.** The plan fixes the placed coverage's monthly premium, the deductible on a claim under placed coverage and the maximum claim payment, and it fixes the highest deductible the borrower's own policy may carry.

**4. Nature of placed coverage.** Placed coverage is single-interest physical damage coverage protecting only the company's interest in the vehicle. It never provides liability coverage or any coverage for the borrower. The borrower remains free to buy their own insurance from any insurer at any time.

**5. Reassessment.** The band is reassessed only at renewal, at the product's reassessment interval after placement. A change in the vehicle's value during a placement term never changes the plan mid-term.

**6. Tracking fee.** No fee is charged for insurance tracking.

## Applying the terms

| Moment | Value that decides the plan |
|---|---|
| Opening of the tracking record | the vehicle's value at opening |
| Placement | the product's plan-band valuation on the placement date |
| During a placement term | no change, whatever happens to the value |
| Renewal | the band is reassessed |

**Hypothetical:** a record opened in CollateralGuard Plan C goes to placement when the vehicle's valuation on the placement date falls in the CollateralGuard Plan B band. Placement sets the record to CollateralGuard Plan B, and the Plan B premium, claim deductible, maximum claim payment and borrower deductible ceiling then apply. If the valuation then moves back into the Plan C band during the term, the record stays on Plan B until the band is reassessed at renewal.

**Does placed coverage protect the borrower if they cause an accident?** No. It protects only the company's interest in the vehicle and never includes liability coverage or any coverage for the borrower.
